Strong personal network of relevant enterprise customers, decision-makers, and industry stakeholders across the DACH market. Strong methodological sales orientation: experience implementing structured sales frameworks (MEDDPICC), setting KPIs, establishing process discipline and metrics. Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities, experienced in developing and executing complex sales strategies, contract negotiation, and operational leadership. Hands-on mentality: comfortable personally selling major deals, rolling up sleeves in a scale-up context. Ability to work cross-functionally and influence peers, leaders and external partners.
